lines.en: The Light Stays On For You
Three months later the top floor became a public library — open at night, for people who work the night shift. On opening day, a brass plaque bore a security guard's name.
lines.zh: 三个月后，那层顶楼改成了一间公共图书馆——夜间开放，专为值夜班的人。开馆那天，铜牌上刻着一个保安的名字。

lines.en: Standing beside you, he said, "My father would have liked this."
lines.zh: 他站在你旁边，说："我父亲会喜欢的。"

lines.en: Then he looked down at you. "I didn't buy this one. We built it." The top-floor light stays off. Two adults, one city, and no meeting behind it.
lines.zh: 然后他低头看你："这次不是我买下的。是我们一起。"顶楼的灯一直没有再亮。两个成年人，一座城市，背后没有任何一场会议。

lines.en: But on the third weekend of every month, the light on that top floor comes on — he flies back, cancels everything, for one drink and one conversation.
lines.zh: 但每个月第三个周末，那层顶楼的灯都会亮起来——他会飞回来，什么会都不开，只为一杯酒和一场对话。

lines.en: In the seventh month he sent a photo late at night: the glow of another city outside another window.
lines.zh: 第七个月，他在深夜发来一张照片：纽约的窗外也是整座城市的光。

lines.en: The caption was four words. "Still not the same." The top-floor light stays off. Two adults, one city, and no meeting behind it.
lines.zh: 附言只有四个字："还是不一样。"顶楼的灯一直没有再亮。两个成年人，一座城市，背后没有任何一场会议。

lines.en: Just a Light on a Top Floor
lines.zh: 他终究只是顶楼的一盏灯

lines.en: You still pass that building sometimes. The top floor is lit some nights, dark on others.
lines.zh: 你后来偶尔还会经过那栋楼。顶层的灯有时亮着，有时不亮。

lines.en: Some people are just a floor in your life — you pressed the wrong button once, and then the right one back. The top-floor light stays off. Two adults, one city, and no meeting behind it.
lines.zh: 有些人只是你人生里的一层楼——你按错了电梯，然后按对了回去的键。顶楼的灯一直没有再亮。两个成年人，一座城市，背后没有任何一场会议。
